title: 電子材料
subtitle: Electronic Materials
educationalGoal: In this lecture, we learn about the material properties of dielectrics and magnetic materials, which are the basic materials in the electronic field along with semiconductors. To understand the polarization phenomenon and dielectric loss of dielectrics and the physical meaning of the magnetism, and also about applications of ferroelectric and ferromagnetic materials to devices. Make it possible to recognize the importance of materials through lectures.
advice:
1. Basics of electronic materials : We learn the basic contents in learning electronic materials, especially the atomic orbital and electron configuration in solids, the bonding between atoms, band structures, and electrical conduction.
2. Dielectric materials and their properties : Learn about polarization, which is a general response phenomenon to the electric field of a solid. After learning the polarization under applying a DC electric field, the complex permittivity is derived under applying an AC electric field, and the dielectric loss. Furthermore, we learn about the properties of ferroelectrics that show strong polarization and their applications.
3. Magnetic materials and their properties : We understand from a microscopic point of view the magnetization phenomena that occur when a substance is placed in a magnetic field, and learn about the basic content of magnetism that determines the magnetic properties of the substance. Learn about the origin and classification of ferromagnetism, and their applications to the field of electrical and electronic engineering. In addition, we will learn about the basics and applications of spintronics that apply electron spin, which has attracted attention in recent years.
books: Electrical and Electronic Materials Engineering, SAIENSU - SHA Co.,Ltd.
requiredKnowledge: The purpose of this lecture is to learn the characteristics and practical applications of the dielectric and magnetic materials that make up the various devices that form the basis of the electrical and electronic engineering field, based on the knowledge learned in the Electronic Engineering and Physical Electronics. You will learn about various materials through this class, but please systematically organize your knowledge.

              In this lecture, we learn about the material properties of dielectrics and magnetic materials, which are the basic materials in the electronic field along with semiconductors. To understand the polarization phenomenon and dielectric loss of dielectrics and the physical meaning of the magnetism, and also about applications of ferroelectric and ferromagnetic materials to devices. Make it possible to recognize the importance of materials through lectures.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              1. Basics of electronic materials : We learn the basic contents in learning electronic materials, especially the atomic orbital and electron configuration in solids, the bonding between atoms, band structures, and electrical conduction.
2. Dielectric materials and their properties : Learn about polarization, which is a general response phenomenon to the electric field of a solid. After learning the polarization under applying a DC electric field, the complex permittivity is derived under applying an AC electric field, and the dielectric loss. Furthermore, we learn about the properties of ferroelectrics that show strong polarization and their applications.
3. Magnetic materials and their properties : We understand from a microscopic point of view the magnetization phenomena that occur when a substance is placed in a magnetic field, and learn about the basic content of magnetism that determines the magnetic properties of the substance. Learn about the origin and classification of ferromagnetism, and their applications to the field of electrical and electronic engineering. In addition, we will learn about the basics and applications of spintronics that apply electron spin, which has attracted attention in recent years.

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              The purpose of this lecture is to learn the characteristics and practical applications of the dielectric and magnetic materials that make up the various devices that form the basis of the electrical and electronic engineering field, based on the knowledge learned in the Electronic Engineering and Physical Electronics. You will learn about various materials through this class, but please systematically organize your knowledge.
